title: Stop a reading loop at zero
prompt: Sum only positive readings until the first zero. Ignore negative readings. Do not inspect readings after the zero marker. Inputs and sum fit in int.

tests.label: Ignore negative
tests.hint: Negative readings do not add to sum.

tests.label: Stop at first zero
tests.hint: Use break when the marker arrives.

hints: continue skips the rest of this iteration.
explanation: The loop moves from left to right. The zero sentinel changes control flow; it is not merely a value to add.
